steps.n3: يخلط اللحم بالبصل المدعوك والزيت ويوضع في الفويل ويغلق جيدا.

en.title: Rolled Roasted Meat
en.intro: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

steps.n1: Slice the onion into rings and mash it with salt, pepper and mixed spice.
steps.n2: Cut the meat into small, even pieces and drizzle with the oil.
steps.n3: Mix the meat with the mashed onion and oil, wrap in foil, and seal well.
steps.n4: Bake for about 2 hours, until fully cooked.

legacySteps: Slice the onion into rings and mash it with salt, pepper and mixed spice.
Cut the meat into small, even pieces and drizzle with the oil.
Mix the meat with the mashed onion and oil, wrap in foil, and seal well.
Bake for about 2 hours, until fully cooked.
